name: Monk Death Shroud Monk
body:
A death shroud monk practices a kind of martial arts that focuses on killing, poison use, and necromantic empowerment.

Death Knell (Sp)

At 1st level, a death shroud monk draws the life out of dying creatures to empower themselves. They can cast death knell as a spell-like ability using their class level as the caster level. The DC for this spell-like ability is 10 + 1/2 the death shroud monk’s class level + their Wisdom modifier. This ability is usable once per day plus one per 3 class levels they have.

At 8th level, they can use this as a swift action once per day on a creature they reduce to below 0 hit points with an unarmed attack or their death touch attack (see below).

This ability replaces stunning fist.

Poison Use (Ex)

At 2nd level, a death shroud monk is trained in the use of poison and never risks poisoning themselves when applying poison to a weapon. This ability replaces the bonus feat at 2nd level.

Death’s Shroud (Ex)

At 3rd level, a death shroud monk gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against death effects and a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks. This ability replaces still mind. The unchained monk gains this ability at 4th level.

Death Touch (Su)

At 6th level, a death shroud monk can replace one of their attacks made during a full attack or as a standard to deliver a death-empowered attack. The attack is a melee touch attack that deals 1d8 negative energy damage per 3 class levels the death shroud monk possesses. This does not heal undead.

This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces the bonus feats at 6th and 14th levels.
